sloka: न हि पश्यामि सदृशं चिन्तयन्ती प्लवङ्गम ।मत्प्रियाख्यानाकस्येह तव प्रत्यभिनन्दनम् ।। ६.११६.१९ ।।
transliteration: na hi paśyāmi sadṛśaṁ cintayantī plavaṅgama ।matpriyākhyānākasyeha tava pratyabhinandanam ।। 6.116.19 ।।

translations.english: "I am not able to see on this earth, a gift befitting the value of your message, which can be given to you to make you happy."
